// Fixture for scripts/test-scripts.sh (wallclock-check): stored as .txt so the tree's
// Go tools never compile it. Every call below is a finding, and the line numbers are
// asserted by the script, so add new cases at the end.
package zzwallclockprobe

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestWaitsAShortRealTime(t *testing.T) {
	ch := make(chan struct{})
	select {
	case <-ch:
	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("late")
	}
	timer := time.NewTimer(500 * time.Millisecond)
	defer timer.Stop()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	ctx2, cancel2 := context.WithDeadline(ctx, time.Now().Add(10*time.Second))
	defer cancel2()
	start := time.Now()
	if time.Since(start) > time.Second {
		t.Fatal("slow")
	}
	// wall-clock:
	_ = time.After(time.Millisecond)
	_ = time.After(29 * time.Second)
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
	_ = &http.Server{ReadHeaderTimeout: 100 * time.Millisecond, IdleTimeout: time.Minute}
	_ = ctx2
	_ = client
}
